inputBoundary: One already-derived finite percentage of a user's observation hours for which GPS locations are available.
outputBoundary: Filter a user below 80% GPS-hour availability and retain the user at or above 80%; equality is retained.
limitations: This binding does not select accepted location observations from actual GPS measurements or operating-system Wi-Fi lookups.
This binding does not group observations by user, construct covered-hour counts, or define the observation-hour denominator.
The requirement for application-usage data over the entire period is a separate user-level source gate.
Stop-event extraction, spatial and temporal thresholds, and DBSCAN location construction are separate downstream source operations.
A missing GPS-hour coverage percentage fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
